import sys
from math import gcd


def integers():
    for line in sys.stdin.buffer:
        for token in line.split():
            yield int(token)


def main():
    data = integers()
    test_cases = next(data)
    answers = []

    for _ in range(test_cases):
        n = next(data)
        adjacency = [[] for _ in range(n)]

        for _ in range(n - 1):
            first = next(data) - 1
            second = next(data) - 1
            adjacency[first].append(second)
            adjacency[second].append(first)

        values = [next(data) for _ in range(n)]
        parent = [-1] * n
        order = []
        stack = [0]

        while stack:
            vertex = stack.pop()
            order.append(vertex)
            for neighbor in adjacency[vertex]:
                if neighbor != parent[vertex]:
                    parent[neighbor] = vertex
                    stack.append(neighbor)

        prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
        for index, vertex in enumerate(order):
            prefix[index + 1] = gcd(prefix[index], values[vertex])

        suffix = [0] * (n + 1)
        for index in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            suffix[index] = gcd(suffix[index + 1], values[order[index]])

        subtree_size = [1] * n
        subtree_gcd = values
        child_sum = [0] * n
        best = 0

        for index in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            vertex = order[index]
            outside_gcd = gcd(
                prefix[index],
                suffix[index + subtree_size[vertex]],
            )
            damage = child_sum[vertex] + outside_gcd
            if damage > best:
                best = damage

            ancestor = parent[vertex]
            if ancestor != -1:
                subtree_size[ancestor] += subtree_size[vertex]
                subtree_gcd[ancestor] = gcd(
                    subtree_gcd[ancestor], subtree_gcd[vertex]
                )
                child_sum[ancestor] += subtree_gcd[vertex]

        answers.append(str(best))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(answers))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
